criteria.text: Given a repo with no settings file, When I run harness-config, Then every setting prints at its default value marked locked or configurable with its source
Given a configurable setting, When I run harness-config set <key> <value>, Then the value is saved to the correct layer (repo or user)
Given a locked setting, When I try to set it, Then the change is refused with a clear message and the enforced value is unchanged

Given both a repo and a user settings file, When settings are resolved, Then user-layer keys read from the user file and repo-layer keys from the repo file, and each resolved setting reports its source
Given an existing settings file with unrelated keys, When I set one key, Then the other keys are preserved (no clobber)
